blockingFindings.description: Directly inspected all five angle views and six pose renders for V17. The measured overskirt group contains 1,330 vertices with one influence each and no upper-leg groups, isolating Hips-only skinning. Despite that change, the back render retains a raised central panel patch and crouch/sit retain long, pointed tails below the seat. Removing thigh-bone transfer alone did not resolve the defect; pose silhouette remains rejected.

V17 crouch and sit still show the undershorts and inner-hip boundary crowded by the pose. These fixed images do not establish continuous garment coverage, clearance or strain; fit remains unverified and rejected.
V17 front, side, back and posed renders still show pronounced triangular faceting across jacket sleeves, shoulders, torso and waist. Surface finish remains rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
